notSetUp.title: Payments are being set up
notSetUp.body: We are finishing the payment setup. Please try again later, or message us on WhatsApp.

loadError.title: We could not load this page
loadError.body: Please refresh the page. If it keeps happening, message us on WhatsApp.

join.title: Join the training
join.purpose: Compare the plans, see what each one includes, and pick the one that fits you.
join.priceSoonHelp: We are finalising this price. Message us on WhatsApp to hear first.
join.pricesAfterTest: See prices after your free test
join.pricesAfterTestText: Take the free diagnostic test first. When you submit it, prices appear here and on your results page.
join.inPersonNote: Includes a seat in an in-person cohort. You choose the cohort at checkout.
join.addonText: You can add it at checkout.

empty.title: No plans yet
empty.body: Plans will appear here soon. Message us on WhatsApp if you want to join now.

active.title: Your training is active
active.renewNote: You can renew when fewer than 14 days are left.
active.renewOpen: Fewer than 14 days left. Renew now; the new period starts when this one ends.

pending.title: You have a payment in progress

join.whatsappText: Hi, I have a question about the CAD Champions training plans.

faq.title: Questions
faq.a1: With Fawran, an instant bank transfer from your bank app. You send the exact amount with a reference code, upload a screenshot, and we confirm it.
faq.a2: As soon as we confirm your transfer. This usually takes a few hours during working hours [TODO-MO: confirm]. We email you when it is active.
faq.a3: Please read our refund policy before you pay.
faq.q4: What if a cohort is full?
faq.a4: Full cohorts can't be chosen. Pick another cohort, choose Online training, or message us and we will tell you when a new cohort opens.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.purpose: Choose your plan and cohort, then pay with Fawran. We hold your place for 48 hours.
checkout.cohortHelp: A cohort is a group that meets at our Lusail studio on set dates. Each cohort has limited seats. Your seat is held for 48 hours while you pay.

noCohorts.title: No open cohorts right now
noCohorts.body: New in-person cohorts open during the year. Choose Online training now, or message us.

checkout.addKitHelp: An optional kit for practising M4 measuring at home.
checkout.terms: I agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and the <refund>refund policy</refund>.
checkout.methodTitle: How do you want to pay?
checkout.fawranHelp: From your bank app. Instant, no card needed.
checkout.skipcashHelp: You go to SkipCash's secure page and come back here.
checkout.reservedToastBody: Pay within 48 hours. We also emailed you the details.
checkout.confirmBody: Thanks! We're checking your transfer. This usually takes a few hours during working hours [TODO-MO: confirm]. You'll get an email.

errors.terms: Tick the box to agree to the Terms and the refund policy.
errors.no_test: Take the free test first; prices open after you submit it.
errors.plan_unavailable: This plan isn't available now. Choose another plan.
errors.price_missing: This plan's price isn't set yet. Message us on WhatsApp.
errors.cohort_full: That cohort just filled up. Choose another cohort.
errors.cohort_closed: That cohort isn't open. Choose another cohort.
errors.coupon_invalid: This coupon code doesn't exist. Check the spelling or remove it.
errors.coupon_expired: This coupon code has expired. Remove it to continue.
errors.coupon_used_up: This coupon code has been used up. Remove it to continue.
errors.coupon_wrong_plan: This coupon code isn't valid for this plan. Remove it or choose another plan.
errors.coupon_wrong_institution: This coupon code is for students of another school. Remove it to continue.
errors.pending_review: You already have a payment we are checking. Wait for our email before paying again.
errors.skipcash_disabled: Card payments aren't available yet. Pay with Fawran.
errors.provider_error: The card payment page didn't open. Try again or pay with Fawran.

errors.signed_out: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.error: Something went wrong. Try again, or message us on WhatsApp.

coupon.label: Coupon code
coupon.help: Have a code from your school or a promotion? Enter it here. The discount shows in your order before you pay.

errors.invalid: This code doesn't exist. Check the spelling and try again.
errors.used_up: This code has been used the maximum number of times.
errors.wrong_plan: This code isn't valid for this plan. Try another plan or remove the code.
errors.wrong_institution: This code is for students of another school.
errors.signed_out: Sign in again to use a code.
errors.error: We couldn't check the code. Try again.

pay.title: Pay with Fawran from your bank app
pay.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
pay.codeNote: Write this code in the transfer note so we can match your payment.

steps.6: Paste the code in the note.
steps.8: Take a screenshot of the confirmation.

pay.help: Fawran works with most banks in Qatar and arrives instantly.
pay.doneText: Tell us about your transfer and upload the screenshot. We check it and confirm your training.
pay.cancelBody: Your reserved place (and any in-person seat) is released. You can start again later; the price and seats may change.
pay.cancelledBody: You can choose a plan again whenever you are ready.

proof.payerNameHelp: The name of the person who sent the money.
proof.referenceHelp: The reference number your bank app shows after the transfer.
proof.date: Date and time of the transfer
proof.screenshotHelp: An image or PDF, up to 10 MB. Make sure the amount and the code are visible.
proof.confirmBody: We will check your transfer against our bank account. You can't edit this proof after sending it.
proof.sentBody: We'll email you when your payment is confirmed.
proof.waitUpload: Wait for the upload to finish.

errors.invalid_name: Enter the name on the bank account (at least 2 letters).
errors.invalid_bank: Choose your bank, or write its name under Other.
errors.invalid_reference: Enter the transfer reference from your bank app.
errors.invalid_date: Enter the date and time of the transfer (not in the future, within the last 30 days).
errors.invalid_file: We couldn't read the screenshot. Upload it again as an image or PDF under 10 MB.
errors.expired: This reservation has expired. Start again from the plans page.
errors.not_allowed: This payment can't take a proof now. Refresh the page to see its status.
errors.not_set_up: Payments are being set up. Try again later.
errors.signed_out: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.error: Something went wrong. Try again, or message us on WhatsApp.

statusPage.title: Payment {code}
statusPage.purpose: Where your payment is and what happens next.
statusPage.awaiting: We're waiting for your transfer. This reservation expires on {date}.
statusPage.awaitingSeat: Your in-person seat is held until then.
statusPage.proof: Thanks! We're checking your transfer. This usually takes a few hours during working hours [TODO-MO: confirm]. You'll get an email.
statusPage.paid: Payment confirmed - your training is active.
statusPage.receiptHelp: Both languages on one receipt. On some devices it opens as a printable page.
statusPage.whatsappText: Hi, my CAD Champions payment {code} needs a new proof. Can you help?
statusPage.expired: This reservation expired. Start again - the price and seats may have changed.

notFound.title: Payment not found
notFound.body: This payment doesn't exist or belongs to another account.

list.title: My payments
list.purpose: Your plan payments, their status and receipts.

empty.title: No payments yet
empty.body: When you choose a plan, your payment shows here.

return.title: Confirming your payment…
return.purpose: Please keep this page open. It takes a few seconds.
return.failedBody: You can try again, or pay with Fawran from the plans page.
return.slow: This is taking longer than usual. You can leave this page; we'll email you when it's confirmed.

admin.title: Payments
admin.purpose: Check each Fawran transfer in your bank app, then approve or reject the proof.
admin.help: Proofs waiting for a check come first. Approving starts the student's training at once and sends the welcome email. A payment can't be approved twice.

empty.title: Nothing waiting - nice.
empty.body: New proofs appear here as soon as a student sends them.

admin.approveBody: Approve only after you see {amount} with code {code} in the bank app. The student's training starts now and they get the welcome email.
admin.approvedBody: The training is active and the student was emailed.
admin.rejectBody: The student sees the reason in both languages and can upload a new proof.
admin.rejectedBody: The student was emailed with the reason.
admin.reasonRequired: Choose a reason or write one.

not_received.en: We have not received this transfer in our account yet.
not_received.ar: لم يصل هذا التحويل إلى حسابنا بعد.

amount_wrong.en: The amount sent is different from the amount due.
amount_wrong.ar: المبلغ المحوَّل يختلف عن المبلغ المطلوب.

unreadable.en: We can't read the screenshot. Please upload a clearer one.
unreadable.ar: لا نستطيع قراءة الصورة. ارفع صورة أوضح من فضلك.

wrong_account.en: The transfer went to a different account.

no_code.en: We can't match the transfer: the reference code is missing from the note.
no_code.ar: لا نستطيع مطابقة التحويل: رمز الدفع غير موجود في الملاحظة.

errors.already_handled: Someone already handled this payment. Refresh to see its status.
errors.plan_duration_missing: This plan has no number of days. Set duration_days on the plan first.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.paidNote: Paid in full. Thank you for joining CAD Champions.
receipt.htmlNote: This is a printable receipt. Use your browser's print to save it as a PDF.
